hibid.proof: enumerated total equals hydrated count equals unique eventItemId count

ajwillner.proof: API total equals collected count equals unique item-id count
ajwillner.recordEvidence: Search records include full description fields and all image variants; no detail-page crawl is required.

saleCatalog.stableId: product id from canonical product URL
saleCatalog.proof: contiguous advertised ranges equal collected count equal unique product-id count

category.stableId: product id from canonical product URL
category.proof: advertised result total equals collected count equals unique product-id count

auctionSearch.response: JSON object containing head, body, and pagination HTML fragments
auctionSearch.stableId: canonical sale target host plus path; external redirect backurl is unwrapped
auctionSearch.proof: advertised sale total equals collected card count equals unique canonical-sale identity count

account.proof: explicit total plus exact pages, explicit empty state, or non-empty settled canonical DOM
account.privacy: opaque an values, account identity, bidder aliases, email, phone, street addresses, invoices, and payment data are not retained

auctionninja.note: Sale catalog and category pages expose no reusable listing JSON API; exact server-rendered pagination is authoritative.

calendar.proof: canonical auction identities remain stable after a settled-bottom audit

enumerate.response: server-rendered text/html with one new Lot(...) record per item

aar.proof: unfiltered advertised total or deterministic filtered pagination exhaustion equals collected count equals unique itemId count; every item detail response must preserve auctionId and itemId
aar.privacy: bidder aliases from embedded Lot records are discarded before export

enumerate.captureAndReplay: Observe the native browser request at document-start, bind it to the normalized route/filter/seller scope, ignore FlipperAddon replay traffic, and replay bounded page changes through credentialless abortable Tampermonkey requests.

enrich.identityRequirement: Response accountId and assetId must match the requested identity.
enrich.boundedPolicy: Hydrate at most 90 missing descriptions per export with concurrency 8; audit deferred records and never treat a blank description as negative evidence.

govdeals.proof: x-total-count equals collected count equals unique accountId:assetId count with an unchanged route and request-filter fingerprint
govdeals.privacy: sessionId, request-header values, cookies, authorization data, account tokens, and seller contact PII remain transient and are never committed.
govdeals.fallback: Fail closed for an unavailable/stale capture, isAPIFailureActive, missing or drifting total, malformed accountId:assetId, seller/filter drift, or incomplete enrichment. A static DOM snapshot is partial-only and never exact coverage.

ebay.stableId: transaction, order-line, or item id appropriate to the active route
ebay.proof: visible result total equals collected count equals unique lifecycle-record count
ebay.privacy: Buyer PII is removed before export.

facebook.proof: settled-bottom audit with no missing canonical identities
facebook.note: Private GraphQL operations are not persisted or replayed.
